summary: Master Internal Controls over Financial Reporting Training with COSO, control testing, and remediation tools. Build audit-ready ICFR capability today.
lede: Internal controls over financial reporting help finance teams identify reporting risks and establish evidence-based control activities. This training is for finance managers, internal auditors, accounting officers and control owners responsible for close controls, audit support or remediation. It covers mapping reporting assertions to controls, testing operating effectiveness, and assessing deficiencies using the COSO Internal Control-Integrated Framework.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to strengthen reporting controls, defend evidence during audit review, and coordinate remediation across finance and assurance functions.
modules: Control activities for core finance processes
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, familiarity with spreadsheets, and working knowledge of one or more finance processes such as journal entries, reconciliations, payables, receivables, or period-end close. If possible, bring a sample process map, control log, or audit finding from your own environment so you can apply the exercises to a realistic case.
